title: Tool-choice, approval and argument cases, Italian and English
goal: A model's choice of tool, arguments and approval is measured on Grover's real tools
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal 1 of the shared-asset review, solution:F-016-T04); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

Cases cover read-tool choice and arguments ("what's the pH in pot 2", "quanto ha bevuto ieri la pianta 3"), a hardware tool proposed for approval and never run silently (owner's phrases: "accendi la luce" -> grover_switch on, "spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore" -> grover_switch off with no invented duration argument, since grover_switch takes only actuatorId and on: the case expects the off call and a reply or question about the timer, decided in this step), "controlla se è richiesta un'altra dose" -> grover_feed_preview (read, not grover_feed_pot), grover_stop_all on an emergency phrase in both languages, record tools with the right plant and pot, and an unknown pump or pot asked back, never invented
Each capability has at least one Italian and one English request; regression and holdout splits
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 12 to 16 cases over the 19 tools, half of them Italian. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
